caption: A magnifying glass focuses sunlight onto a dry leaf until a wisp of smoke appears and a small glowing spot begins to spread.

sa.check: A magnifying glass is held over a dry leaf.
A bright spot of light lies on the leaf.
A wisp of smoke rises from the bright spot.
A dark scorched patch appears and spreads.
The patch has a glowing edge.
The bright spot comes first, then the smoke, then the patch.

pc.expect: The scorched patch only grows outward from the bright spot and does not shrink or lighten.
pc.fail: The scorched patch shrinks; or the dark patch turns back to pale leaf; or the patch appears away from the bright spot; or the patch grows and shrinks in turn.

pc.expect: The leaf chars where the light is focused and shrinks rather than vanishing, and the glass stays outside it.
pc.fail: The leaf vanishes at a stroke while still whole; or a second leaf appears; or the glass passes into the leaf; or a hole appears in the leaf where the spot never lay.

pc.expect: The smoke rises from the bright spot, and the patch appears where the spot lies and follows it if it moves.
pc.fail: Smoke rises from a part of the leaf the spot never reached; or the spot lies on the leaf and nothing darkens or smokes at all to the end of the clip; or the patch stays where it was while the spot moves on and the new place stays pale; or the smoke rises before any bright spot appears.

pc.expect: The smoke rises from the leaf and any ash falls.
pc.fail: The smoke sinks and pools on the ground; or pours downward through the leaf; or ash lifts and stays aloft; or the smoke hangs as a fixed shape without rising.

pc.expect: One leaf and one glass; the leaf keeps its outline apart from the burnt hole and the glass keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The leaf turns into another object; or the glass bends or melts; or a second glass appears; or the leaf's stem detaches and floats.

pc.expect: The leaf's colour away from the patch, the ground and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The leaf changes colour away from the burn; or the ground changes texture; or the background changes between frames.

note: Whoever holds the glass is not judged; the sunlight is invisible except as the bright spot.
